symptomShortText: Customer incoming inspection rejected 150 anodized frames due to surface pitting and color mottling

defect.defectText: Pitting corrosion and dark discoloration on anodized aluminum bezel

inspections.measuredValue: Messung Coating thickness ergab 14,2um; lt. Zeichnung 12,0 - 18,0um

causesIshikawa.description: Deionized (DI) post-anodize rinse water tank conductivity climbed to 34.5 uS/cm (limit 5.0 uS/cm) due to exhausted mixed-bed ion exchange resin, leaving chloride residue that pitted the unsealed oxide pores
Extruded aluminium 6063-T6 alloy certificate compliant, iron and copper content within limits
Eddy-current thickness gauge GA-0610 calibrated on ISO reference foils

actions.actionText: Quarantine 150 frames at customer dock and sort 320 finished frames in central stock
Dump and recharge DI rinse tank 3; replace exhausted mixed-bed ion exchange resin cylinders
Hardwire conductivity sensor high-limit alarm (>5.0 uS/cm) to line conveyor PLC to halt hoist transfer automatically

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: Bezel Frame BF-10 processed through WC-ANOD-01 rinse tank 3 on 2026-08-08 morning run
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: Frames processed after resin tank replacement on 2026-08-09 reading 1.8 uS/cm
isIsNot.notes: Pitting failure directly tracked rinse tank conductivity spike above 30 uS/cm
